contracts.name: install-written-paths
contracts.description: Manifest of paths bassclef install writers created. Upstream discipline hooks consult it (via lib/install-written-paths.sh) to skip install-written files, firing discipline on author-edited paths only. CLI's bassclef init writes it. Registry vendored from bassclef-upstream main 320f445b per ADR-059 step 4; test_refs points at cli's test (tests/init-install-written-paths.test.ts) rather than upstream's lib/tests/install-written-paths.test.sh — one-field delta per cli#415 body.

hoare_pre_post.precondition: File at state/install-written-paths.json exists and parses as JSON matching the schema; writer runs in bassclef-cli bassclef init OR upstream fallback at lib/install-written-paths.sh L250-256.
hoare_pre_post.postcondition: For every path P in entries[], upstream pre-commit-gate.sh skips discipline on P; writer identity in entries[].writer matches one of the writer enum values.
